nvitk.cli._common.run_local(input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, *, backend: str = 'cpu', mask_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, runner: collections.abc.Callable[Ellipsis, Any], runner_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None) → pathlib.Path¶

Read input, run tool, save output locally.

nvitk.cli._common.run_sge(*, tool: str, subcommand: str, module_file: str, input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, backend: str = 'cpu', mask_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None = None, direct_submit: bool = False, no_remote: bool = False, dry_run: bool = False, extra_cli_args: list[str] | None = None) → None¶

Emit (and optionally submit) an SGE job script that runs tool’s subcommand worker on the cluster: builds the containerized worker command, writes the qsub script via emit_submit_script() (unless direct_submit skips straight to submit_tool_job()), and — unless no_remote/direct_submit — runs it over SSH on the configured cluster host if NVITK_SGE_SSH_* env vars are set.

nvitk.cli._common.dispatch_tool(*, tool: str, subcommand: str, module_file: str, input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, submit: str, backend: str = 'gpu', mask_path: pathlib.Path | None, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None, direct_submit: bool, no_remote: bool, dry_run: bool, runner: collections.abc.Callable[Ellipsis, Any], runner_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None) → None¶

Route a tool invocation to either local execution (run_local()) or SGE submission (run_sge()) based on submit, after activating the requested backend.
